html:
Discover the beauty of Van Trinh cave Ninh Binh, visitors feel like they are lost in the middle of a magical maze, the scenery of mountains and rivers is a charming and poetic scene. In addition, visitors can also experience a cruise to admire the poetic scenery.

Van Cave is located halfway up the mountain with a charming and poetic landscape. From the cave entrance, visitors can gaze out at the wild beauty of the mountains and forests, peaceful rivers, or golden rice fields.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ninh Binh, visitors should visit Van Cave to feel its own beauty. The cave is likened to a maze with stalactites stacked on top of each other in strange animal shapes, very eye-catching.

Inside the cave, visitors will feel the cool climate, with beautiful stalactites, visitors can take souvenir photos, next to the magical shimmering stalagmites, with vivid stalactites shaped like bamboo shoots, or strange animals.

The stalactites look like a flea market from afar, or sitting gods, or chess boards with images of gods playing chess, or the shape of water drops…

Traveling to Van Trinh Cave in which season is the best

If this is your first time in Ninh Binh, visit Van Trinh Cave to feel the natural beauty that nature has bestowed upon Ninh Binh. Inside Van Trinh Cave, there are small caves such as Thien Ha Cave, Tien Ca Cave, Vai Gioi Cave… which are some of the most beautiful caves in Ninh Binh.

Visiting the most beautiful cave every summer, this is also the peak season of Ninh Binh, and this is also the lotus blooming season, visitors will be delighted to admire the beauty of the lotus flowers blooming, spreading their fragrant scent in the wind, and this is also the most beautiful moment for visitors to visit Ninh Binh.

In addition, if you are a person who likes sightseeing, you should travel to Ninh Binh in the spring, the season of many vibrant festivals and is very suitable for visitors to visit, because the spring weather is very cool and it is also the occasion for visitors to visit the temples in the early spring, praying for a healthy and peaceful new year.

However, to explore the beauty of the caves, you should travel to Ninh Binh in the summer, when the weather in the North is hot, but when you enter the cave, it will bring you cool air, and explore the natural beauty that nature has bestowed on Ninh Binh.

What to eat when traveling to Van Trinh cave, Ninh Binh?

Kim Son vermicelli with meatballs

White and chewy vermicelli, with crispy meatballs, often eaten with raw vegetables such as bean sprouts, sliced ​​banana leaves, basil, Vietnamese balm, etc., along with a famous aromatic broth, especially in the early morning in the cold weather, enjoy a hot bowl of vermicelli, there is nothing more interesting.

Ant egg sticky rice

This dish is sought after by many diners, the ant eggs here are taken by the locals from the limestone mountains so they are very fresh and delicious, combined with grilled sticky rice to create a famous specialty.

Fish stewed with a coconut shell

The name of fish stewed with a coconut shell is no longer strange to anyone, however, the dish of Fish stewed with a coconut shell is sought after by many tourists, the fish stewed with a coconut shell and enjoyed with hot rice is nothing more interesting.

Mountain goat meat

A specialty that is no longer strange to anyone, goat meat is processed into many different dishes such as: Raw goat with lemon leaves, stir-fried and grilled, or used for hot pot, all of which have their own delicious flavors.

Crispy rice

A specialty that is not only enjoyed when having the opportunity to set foot here, but visitors also buy it as a gift for friends and relatives.

So when coming to Ninh Binh tour, visitors not only visit Trang An eco-tourism area, Tam Coc – Bich Dong tourist area, Cuc Phuong national park, Van Long lagoon… but also visit unique caves, the most prominent of which is Van Trinh cave, a masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon this place.
